top_story.headline: Rep. Joaquin Castro Introduces West Bank and Gaza Settlement Sanctions Bill With 42 Cosponsors
top_story.dek: The bill, one of 97 measures introduced in the House on October 1, 2026, is referred to four House committees.
paragraphs: Rep. Joaquin Castro (D-TX-20) introduced H.R. 10642, a bill to impose sanctions with respect to settlements in the West Bank and Gaza. The Congressional Record lists 42 cosponsors beside Castro.

The bill is referred to the Committee on Foreign Affairs, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, Financial Services, and Ways and Means. Introduction is the only action recorded; the House adjourned the same day until October 5, 2026.

sections.headline: House Meets Briefly on October 1 and Sees 97 Measures Introduced; Senate Records Only Its Opening
paragraphs: The House convened and adjourned at 11:33 a.m. on Thursday, October 1, 2026, until 4:30 p.m. on Monday, October 5, 2026. The Congressional Record for the day shows no recorded votes in the House pages read. The Senate's only entry is its opening: it met at 10:30 a.m. with Sen. Cynthia M. Lummis presiding.

House members introduced 80 bills (H.R. 10640 through H.R. 10719), one joint resolution, one concurrent resolution and 15 simple resolutions. Besides the Castro sanctions bill, the most notable are H.J.Res. 218, a constitutional amendment to abolish the Electoral College, and H.Res. 1603, which expresses concern about book banning and has dozens of cosponsors. Many of the simple resolutions are commemorative awareness days and months. Sponsor party, state and district come from the Congress.gov API.
